description: Single source of truth for all user-facing strings. Keys are identifiers (never change). Values are the displayed text. This is the only directory where non-English text is permitted (in values only, not keys).

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.line-1: Reach the end of a stage to clear it.
tutorial.line-2: Move with the arrow keys or A and D. Jump with Space or the up arrow.
tutorial.line-3: Shoot with Z or J; hold shoot to raise the shield. Land on an enemy from above to stomp it.
tutorial.line-4: Hold Down plus Special to clear the screen, or Up plus Special for invincibility.
tutorial.line-5: Collect musical notes to fill the HUD tracker. Press Escape or P to pause.

credits.title: Credits
credits.line-2: A browser platformer built with plain ES modules and the HTML5 canvas.
credits.line-3: Design and development: the Super Fruit World project.

controls.title: Controls
controls.line-1: Move: arrow keys or A and D
controls.line-3: Shoot: Z or J | Shield: hold shoot
controls.line-4: Stomp: land on an enemy from above | Dash: Shift | Crouch: Down arrow
controls.line-5: Screen Clear: hold Down + Special | Invincibility: hold Up + Special
controls.line-8: Menus: arrows to navigate, Enter to confirm, Escape to go back

input.navigate-hint: Arrows: Navigate | Confirm: Select | Back: Return

strawberry-fields.intro-1: Welcome to Strawberry Fields! Reach the exit door at the far end of the stage.
strawberry-fields.intro-2: Collect the big strawberry before you leave. Press confirm to dismiss this message.

avocado-grove.intro-1: This is Avocado Grove. The terraces climb toward a single avocado at the heart of the grove.
avocado-grove.intro-2: Eight notes are spread along the route. Collect all of them to earn a continue.
avocado-grove.intro-3: The avocado unlocks the power of green. Ammunition then lets you shoot.

banana-beach.intro-1: Banana Beach stretches along the tide pools toward the far shore.
banana-beach.intro-2: Jump the boardwalk gaps and watch the patrols on the sand.
banana-beach.intro-3: The banana at the end of the beach unlocks the power of yellow.

blueberry-peaks.intro-1: Blueberry Peaks climbs through narrow ledges and deep pits.
blueberry-peaks.intro-2: Time each jump: the higher ledges leave little room for error.
blueberry-peaks.intro-3: Two checkpoints mark the climb. The blueberry waits at the summit.

starfruit-caverns.intro-1: Starfruit Caverns drops through a crystal shaft into a still underground lake.
starfruit-caverns.intro-2: A key rests on the lake shore. Take it before you leave the caverns.
starfruit-caverns.intro-3: The starfruit in the vault unlocks the power of cyan.

pitaya-canyon.intro-1: Pitaya Canyon is scorched ground guarded by spikes and shooters.
pitaya-canyon.intro-2: Keep moving through the open stretches and use cover where you can.
pitaya-canyon.intro-3: The pitaya at the canyon heart unlocks the power of magenta.

fruit-basket-citadel.intro-1: The Fruit Basket Citadel is the last trial of the fruit world.
fruit-basket-citadel.intro-2: Slopes, water, ladders and shooters guard the vault inside.
fruit-basket-citadel.intro-3: Reach the fruit basket and unlock the final power of white.

starfruit-caverns-branch.intro-1: The secret-grove key opens a quiet waterfall hidden behind the caverns.
starfruit-caverns-branch.intro-2: Five notes and a bonus starfruit wait at the end of this short route.
